description: This walk follows the Chess Valley Walk from Chorleywood to Chesham. Its an alternative route to the Chess Valley Walk which traditionally runs from Chesham to Rickmansworth. This branch of the trail starts from near Chorleywood tube station and takes you path Chorleywood Common and the Chorleywood House Estate to the River Chess. You then follow the riverside path west to the Grade I listed Chenies Manor House which has some beautiful gardens. You continue past Latimer and Chessmount before finishing at Chesham.
